role: Safe accessors for HealthKit quantity and category type constants: return nil plus a warning log instead of force-unwrapping. (The finite-value HKQuantity guard in use is HealthSampleFactory.quantitySample.)

units.does: Returns HKQuantityType for the identifier, or nil after a .warning debugLog naming the caller. Used at 22 call sites (HR/HRV/vitals/workout importer reads and exports).

branches.effect: false: warning log, returns nil (callers skip/return); true: returns type

units.does: Returns HKCategoryType for the identifier (used for .sleepAnalysis), or nil after a warning log.

branches.effect: false: warning log, nil; true: type
